instructions: Copy this template for a specific execution. Do not overwrite the committed blank template with customer data or private run evidence.
Freeze the actual runtime, feature/market scope, authorized fixtures, owners and selected required subcases before any U decision. Reference SHA is historical design evidence, not the tested runtime.
Seven packages are logical coverage groups. Select applicable subcases and add conditional assistant/billing branches; do not mark a whole case pass from one representative.
Record actual execution or an explicit controlled evidence reference with matching source/configuration/fixture/run/artifact hashes. Preserve separate engineering and Human conclusions.
Record G1–G5 for each gate separately. A U decision permits its recorded invited-testing scope only; no automatic E/R or public-release approval.

Use controlled evidence URIs and hashes. Never commit credentials, recovery tokens, customer originals, raw prompts or private generated outputs. This metadata validator never runs product tests or infers readiness.
